description.value: A cultured node spliced across the pain pathway. You are not slowed or made off-guard by being at low Hit Points, and you reduce the DC of flat checks to recover from persistent damage by 2.

cinderfall.incomplete: Neither clause has a rule-element hook: 'not slowed/off-guard at low HP' removes a penalty pf2e doesn't actually apply as a baseline rule (nothing to cancel), and reducing the flat-check DC to recover from persistent damage has zero precedent anywhere -- confirmed absence, since the real official Stanching rune (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/stanching-major.json), which does exactly this for persistent bleed specifically, ships rules: [] too.
